section.title: Profile format
section.para: A profile defines which options to use during installation: which product to install, localization settings, partitioning schema, etc. Agama profiles are written in Jsonnet which is a superset of JSON. It brings a few advantages:

listitem.para: More relaxed syntax which makes it easier to read and write.
Support for comments and multi-line values.

section.para: Let’s have a look to an example to get an idea. The following profile is rather small: it just instructs Agama to install Tumbleweed and defines a first user so you can log in.

Reading throught the following sections you can find the supported configuration values. The documentation includes several examples to make it easier to write your own profiles. Alternatively, you can check the JSON Schema to learn about the supported elements.
If you are interested in the dynamic bits, you can check the Writing a dynamic profile section.
